inputs.name: DesktopExperimentService.plan.sources
inputs.description: A map from source asset paths to their source text. plan checks each configured asset path and requires a non-empty source whose SHA-256 hash matches the configured hash.

inputs.name: DesktopExperimentService.plan.options
inputs.description: Carries filesystem paths used by the patch: dataPath is JSON-stringified into CODEX_ELECTRON_USER_DATA_PATH, and catalogPath is passed to HarnessPickerBridge. Neither value is validated.

inputs.name: replaceOnce.source
inputs.description: The source text searched and rewritten by replaceOnce. It must produce exactly two parts when split on anchor or the function throws.

inputs.name: replaceOnce.anchor
inputs.description: The exact substring used to split source before replacement. The split must produce exactly two parts or replaceOnce throws.

inputs.name: replaceOnce.replacement
inputs.description: The text substituted between the parts returned by splitting source on anchor. It is inserted verbatim.

outputs.name: DesktopExperimentService.plan
outputs.description: A new Map copied from sources with configured desktop asset source strings patched. The patches set environment overrides, change the app name and thread unload delay, add picker-bridge routing, and adjust model-filter and remote-control behavior.

outputs.name: replaceOnce
outputs.description: The source string with replacement inserted between the two parts produced by splitting on anchor. The function throws unless that split produces exactly two parts.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: The implementation throws Error when a configured asset source is absent, empty, or has a SHA-256 hash different from its configured hash, or when source.split(anchor).length is not exactly 2.
